_comment: MN counties cross-FY source-gap residual + city link-residual (MNCO-01/MNLINK-01, CONTEXT D-08). county_residual = counties enumerated with no Governmental Funds financial total (NOT created as municipalities) — ZERO found. link_residual = cities whose ParentEntityName cell is blank in EVERY city workbook (no phantom link; a sourced-data gap, not dropped data). union_distinct_counties uses normalized stems so cross-FY casing variants (e.g. Lake of the Woods) collapse to one = the 87 MN counties. Generated 2026-06-27.
source: Minnesota Office of the State Auditor City/County Finances Report

notes.casing_variants: Lake of the Woods spelled 3 ways across FY2013-2021 in the source; consolidated to canonical "Lake of the Woods County" (scripts/mnCountyNameCanonical.json prevents recurrence).
